row.name: God's Brand Christian Academy of Tyler

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operation has an inactive Franchise Tax as of 8/11/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: During the inspection a caregiver was observed using an inappropriate disciple method when yelling at children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: This standard was reviewed during an investigation. During the inspection garbage was observed throughout the operation including the outdoor play area and was accessible to children. Foul odors in the restrooms were also present during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: This standard was reviewed during an investigation. During the inspection it was observed that the floors were not cleaned and restroom door/lock needed to be repaired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient. The infant B classroom was out of child ratio with two staff. The two staff were present with 13 children in the older infant classroom aging from 7 months to 3 years old and out of ratio by 3 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: This standard was evaluated as a part of the investigation inspection and found to be deficient. The caregivers in the infant classroom did not know the number of children they were responsible for during the walkthrough of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: This standard was evaluated as part of the investigation and found to be deficient.  One of the children present in the infant B classroom at the time of the inspection was 3 years old and the youngest infant present was 7 months old.  The 3 year old is more than 18 months older than the youngest infant.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled: This standard was evaluated at the investigation inspection and found deficient. The operation did not have a current teacher list posted of the teachers employed at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: It was observed that a caregiver did not wash their hands in between the diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan: This standard was reviewed in relation to the reported allegations and found to be deficient. The operation did not have a completed food allergy plan for a child with a documented food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child: This standard was reviewed in relation to the reported allegations and found to be deficient. The operation served a child with a known food allergy the item they were allergic to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Must not serve identified foods to allergic child (26 TAC §746.3301(i))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection one classroom was out of ratio. This was corrected at inspection. There was one caregiver with 10 chilren ages 18m-23m.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: This standard was reviewed in relation to the reported allegations and found to be deficient. The operation failed to provide first aid to an injured child when needed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: The garbage can in the school age room did not have a lid and had garbage items in it and availble to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: Emergency drill documentation was observed and found that the time of the drill was not documented for the year of 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Drills (26 TAC §746.5205(4))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver was observed not washing a child's hands after a diaper change. This was corrected when the inspector asked the caregiver to wash the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Staff files were reviewed and one staff did not have documentation of orientation to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: Staff files were reviewed and one file was missing a current drivers license.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child: During inspection the caregiver was observed walking away from the changing table and leaving a child unattended on the table, not buckled in, waiting to have their diaper changed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Must Keep Hand on Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Staff files were reviewed and 2 staff with hire dates in February have not completed the 24 hours of pre-service that is required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center: During inspection the menu observed was not being followed for snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Daily menu, including all snacks and meals served by the child care center (26 TAC §746.401(6))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During inspection it was observed that the school age children were watching tv during nap time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The changing pad in the two year old room was torn and not able to be sanitized correctly anymore.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: During inspection it was obsereved that the most recent inspection form was not posted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: During inspection 10 children records were reviewed and 9 of the 10 records were missing the admission date, 1 record was missing the release individuals and 4 records were missing updated shot records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher: The fire extinguisher in the van was not charged.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Fire Extinguisher (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(5))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The annual health inspection was not available at the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))
